raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #42684.

`NixlKVManager.set_kv_buffer_tensors()` does not accept the `slot_layer_ids` keyword, but both call sites pass it whenever `SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER=1` and the model is non-MLA:

- `python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/prefill.py` (`_init_kv_manager`)
- `python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/decode.py` (role-switch path)

With `--disaggregation-transfer-backend nixl` the server therefore crashes during kv_manager init, before serving any request:

```
File ".../sglang/srt/disaggregation/prefill.py", line 332, in _init_kv_manager
    kv_manager.set_kv_buffer_tensors(
TypeError: NixlKVManager.set_kv_buffer_tensors() got an unexpected keyword argument 'slot_layer_ids'
```

The Mooncake backend (`mooncake/conn.py`) already accepts and stores this argument; NIXL was not updated when the parameter was introduced. This happens regardless of TP topology (the flag is evaluated at init), and only for non-MLA models (MLA skips the call via the `is_mla_backend` guard).

Reproduced on v0.5.19, v0.5.20 and current `main`. Full repro, control run and `check_env` are in #42684.

## Modifications

Align the NIXL signature with Mooncake in `python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/nixl/conn.py`:

- add `slot_layer_ids: Optional[List[int]] = None` to `NixlKVManager.set_kv_buffer_tensors`
- stash it in `kv_buffer_tensors["slot_layer_ids"]` for parity

The NIXL staged send path does not yet consume `slot_layer_ids` (it does not pair slots by layer id for PP>1 the way Mooncake does), so runtime behaviour is otherwise unchanged. This PR only removes the startup crash; PP>1 + draft-pool support for the NIXL staged path can follow separately.

**Overlap note:** the same hunk is present incidentally in #40909 (hetero-TP for hybrid SWA) and #40861 (Intel XPU staging), both of which need it to get past init. It is split out here so it can land independently of those larger changes; whichever merges second needs only a trivial rebase.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A — no change to transfer logic; a pure signature fix. Homogeneous-TP requests do not use the staging path at all (`require_staging` is only set when `prefill attn_tp_size != decode attn_tp_size`).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (No existing test covers this setter; the regression is a startup `TypeError`. Happy to add a minimal one if reviewers want it.)
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results. (N/A, no logic change)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Test

- `python -m py_compile python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/nixl/conn.py`
- Repro from #42684: `SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER=1 python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --disaggregation-mode prefill --disaggregation-transfer-backend nixl --tp 1` crashes on v0.5.20 at `prefill.py:332`.
- **Verified on H100** with this PR's `conn.py` overlaid on `lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.20`: staging buffers allocate, no `TypeError`, P/D warmup passes, server reaches "The server is fired up and ready to roll!". Full log in the PR comment below.

files.patch:
@@ -621,15 +621,26 @@ def _register_staging_memory(self, ptr: int, size: int):
                 f"(ptr=0x{ptr:x}, size={size})"
             )
 
-    def set_kv_buffer_tensors(self, k_buffers: list, v_buffers: list, page_size: int):
+    def set_kv_buffer_tensors(
+        self,
+        k_buffers: list,
+        v_buffers: list,
+        page_size: int,
+        slot_layer_ids: Optional[List[int]] = None,
+    ):
         # NOTE: matches mooncake behavior -- staging buffers are now
         # created in __init__ (per-worker), independent of the kv
         # tensors. This setter only stashes the tensor metadata used by
         # send_kvcache_staged().
+        # slot_layer_ids follows the staging slot order (every k_buffer, then
+        # every v_buffer), which is not kv_args.kv_layer_ids once a draft pool
+        # is registered. Stored for parity with mooncake; the NIXL staged path
+        # does not yet pair slots by layer id.
         self.kv_buffer_tensors = {
             "k_buffers": k_buffers,
             "v_buffers": v_buffers,
             "page_size": page_size,
+            "slot_layer_ids": list(slot_layer_ids or []),
         }
 
     def register_staging_room_bootstrap(self, room, bootstrap_infos, receiver):
